# synchronicity.one

> synchronicity.one sp. z o. o. builds and runs the systems an organisation depends on, using open-source software and servers the client controls. Based in Lublin, Poland. The Polish language counterpart of this company is 41.pl.

## What we do

- Your own private cloud: email, files, calendars and chat brought together in Nextcloud or another open-source platform. Custom development when no existing platform fits.
- Programming that fills the gaps: scripts, API integrations, webhooks, plugins, calculators and forms.
- Automation that removes manual work: reports that write themselves, data moving between systems on its own, unattended scheduled processes.
- AI on your own data: LLMs reading the client's own documents and records on servers they control, and symbolic AI when an answer has to be repeatable and explainable.
- Websites and online stores: static sites through to WP/Woo stores, built for speed and verified with real-user data.
- Infrastructure that stays up: Linux servers, updates, monitoring and encrypted backups.
